title: Define ownership and bounded reclamation for retained launcher test temp
outcome: Retained private launcher temp has an explicit owner and reclamation lifecycle that preserves live and evidence-retained runs.
acceptance: Document and implement an owned lifecycle for .tmp/ow/test-* linked to run artifacts or task/worktree retention, preserving live PID, marker, containment and link checks.
Use repository-local controls to show eligible owned stale temp can be reclaimed and live, foreign, unknown or evidence-retained temp remains untouched; no broad shared-temp sweep.
